sourceNote: Appearance cues inspired by the supplied video stills. Not an official character bible or permission grant.
base: A cinematic photorealistic fan-art interpretation inspired by the black-hooded masked performer visible in the EMPTY BED music video. A black fabric hood and face covering conceal most of the face; expressive eyes remain visible. Dramatic low-key lighting, authentic skin texture around the eyes, restrained color, subtle film grain, realistic photographic composition. Do not invent an official Cinek logo or imply artist approval.
negative: No visible full face, no unverified facial traits, no extra eyes, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no cartoon styling unless explicitly requested.

portrait.label: Eyes / Portrait
portrait.scene: Extreme close-up of the eyes looking straight into the lens, soft cold-blue catchlights, nearly black background, intense yet quiet mood.
portrait.motion: Very slow cinematic push-in toward the eyes, slight natural head movement, steady gaze, minimal atmospheric haze.

rooftop.label: Rooftop / Night
rooftop.scene: Masked performer on a rain-soaked city rooftop at midnight, blurred skyline, distant neon and reflective puddles, medium close-up.
rooftop.motion: Slow lateral camera drift through rooftop rain, gentle fabric movement in wind, atmospheric city bokeh.

studio.label: Music Studio
studio.scene: Masked performer in a dim recording studio, backlit microphone, analog mixer lights, deep shadows and warm tungsten rim lighting.
studio.motion: Slow dolly around microphone, subtle head nod, warm equipment lights flickering softly.

performance.label: Live Performance
performance.scene: Masked performer in silhouette on a dark stage, soft blue backlights, cinematic haze and distant audience lights.
performance.motion: Slow tracking shot across stage, soft haze drifting, subtle stage-light changes.
